sources.title: Open-source image generation model of ddpm-celebahq-finetuned ...
sources.snippet: Model Overview This model is an image generation model based on the DDPM (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models) architecture. It was pre-trained on the CelebAHQ dataset and then fine-tuned for butterfly images for 2 epochs.

sources.title: ddpm-celebahq-finetuned-butterflies-2epochs Open-source Model - Freely ...
sources.snippet: Model Overview This model is a diffusion model based on DDPMPipeline, pre-trained on the CelebAHQ dataset and further fine-tuned for 2 epochs on a butterfly image dataset to generate high-quality butterfly images.
